buttons:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production-style visual design sheet / sprite atlas for the existing Chinese ALCHEMY desktop experiment. The attached existing stone-metal button frames and current game screenshot are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. Keep their dark brown leather/recessed wood interior, thin aged silver carved rectangular rim, restrained antique gold filigree at the corners. Improve typographic quality substantially.
Output a square 2048x2048 reference sheet, a precise 3 columns x 7 rows grid, all 21 tiles equal size. Each tile contains ONE horizontal rectangular button (roughly 5:1 width:height) centered with generous uniform dark empty margins. Flat near-black warm background. No title, no captions, no extra text, no UI screenshots, no duplicate buttons.
Most important: every button must already include its Chinese/Latin label INSIDE the rendered raster artwork, not detached text. All labels use the SAME bold Chinese Song/serif lettering with firm carved strokes, small wedge serifs, restrained shallow gold embossing, pale warm gold #EAD09A highlights, subtle dark bronze contour/shadow. This should look like actual polished fantasy RPG UI, not ordinary webpage text and not illegible calligraphy. Chinese characters must be exact, large, high contrast and readable at small display sizes. Roman words Trial, Episode, JSON, CSV should harmonize as sturdy serif letterforms at matching cap height. Keep font size uniform as far as label lengths allow; long labels get wider usable interior, not excessive tracking. No icons, no gems, no symbols added to labels.
Main actions have a subtle richer antique-gold edge; secondary actions have a dimmer silver/bronze edge; same frame family, glyph style and materials across all. NO perspective, NO skew, NO illustration behind a button, NO strong blooming glow, NO shiny futuristic bevels, NO blue neon, NO extra decorative nonsense glyphs.
EXACT row-major labels, each exactly once, and nothing else:
row 1: "开始实验" | "关于实验" | "练习模式"
row 2: "实验模式" | "使用药水" | "全部投入并结算"
row 3: "进入下一 Trial" | "进入下一 Episode" | "完成实验"
row 4: "导出 JSON 数据" | "导出 CSV 数据" | "返回开始界面"
row 5: "返回" | "继续" | "重试加载"
row 6: "返回封面" | "保留当前实验" | "恢复并导出"
row 7: "恢复进度" | "暂不恢复" | "历史记录"
Render all typography directly as part of each single button image; the words and button must be visually one object.
plaques:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE coherent raster sprite-atlas DESIGN SHEET of non-interactive Chinese fantasy game title plaques. This is the companion to the attached button sheet: MATCH its typeface exactly, the same thick Chinese Song/serif letterforms, same warm pale-gold shallow embossed engraving, same thin carved aged silver rim and restrained antique gold accents, dark brown leather/recessed wood interior. Every label must already be painted inside its plaque as a single complete image. No HTML-style floating captions, no external labels, no title for the sheet. Use the attached existing game screenshot only to understand the understated dark Alchemy UI aesthetic.
Output square 2048x2048, exact uniform THREE columns by NINE rows of cells. One separate plaque per cell, equal visual scale within each row, generous clear margins, near-black warm background. Rows1-8 use horizontal title plaques, noticeably lighter/thinner framing than a clickable button, no bulky jewels and no push-button raised base. Row9 has centered slender upright plaques with normal upright characters stacked top-to-bottom (NOT rotated sideways). No charts, no gameplay scene, no photos, no extra ornaments or text. Font weight/readability must be consistent throughout, high-quality true-to-reference visual material, clean thick lettering at small UI display scale. Longer text can use wider inside margins and slightly smaller but still sturdy letters, never stretch/distort characters.
EXACT row-major text:
row1 "石头" | "操作台" | "药水"
row2 "选择模式" | "被试编号" | "实验任务说明"
row3 "用药结果" | "实验提示" | "数据备份提示"
row4 "开始新实验" | "返回封面" | "继续实验"
row5 "用药前" | "用药后" | "本次药水"
row6 "正式实验" | "练习" | "累计积分"
row7 "EPISODE" | "TRIAL" | "正在准备炼金实验"
row8 "原石 1" | "原石 2" | "原石 3"
row9 VERTICAL: "药水" | "红色" | "青绿色"
Chinese exact spelling is critical. EPISODE/TRIAL use the same family of sturdy classical Roman serif uppercase, matching the button sheet Latin type. No extra decorative symbols inside text. This is an asset-design proposal, do not redraw any actual potion or stone stimuli.
